name: Isadora Mwangi-Thorvaldsen
location: The Shelf, near Halsted and Chicago Ave

physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with defined shoulders and wiry forearms — built for mobility rather than strength. Suggests someone who moves frequently through tight spaces.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep brown with natural copper undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a practical crown braid, occasionally loose
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle amber flecks
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm mid-brown complexion with golden undertones
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin with fine laugh lines around her eyes. Minimal makeup — usually just brow definition and a lip stain. A small scar runs through her left eyebrow (old break, never quite healed straight).
distinguishing_marks: Three-line scarification on her right temple, faint but deliberate, likely cultural or ceremonial
Thin, pale burn scar along her left inner wrist, circa 2cm long — likely accidental or from early chrome work
A small tattoo of a compass rose on her collarbone, barely visible unless she wears open-neck clothing
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. All augmentations are subcutaneous or internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, alert. She moves with economical grace — no wasted motion. Eyes constantly assess spaces and people. Hands gesture expressively when speaking, especially when explaining routes or deals. Leans in when listening, creating false intimacy to build trust.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional. Favors practical layering: fitted black turtlenecks, worn charcoal cargo vests with multiple pockets, reinforced denim in dark indigo. Boots are always clean but scuffed — good-quality polymer composite, not chrome. A faded denim jacket with hand-stitched patches (different neighborhoods she's guided people through) is her signature piece. Wears a slim Φ-chip reader watch on her right wrist and a thin silver chain with a small key fob (contents unknown) around her neck.
